goal: Pressure the deterministic source potential S induced by actual finite centered-cube winners of one complete positive source. No shared-field acceptance-count substitution.

families.capacity_weighted_grid: B38-inspired finite full-coordinate product grid with positive alternating 1D masses; represents a restricted feasible capacity input, not a solved B38 LP.
families.overlap_resolution_mixture: B41 positive mixture of complete n-dimensional tensor grids at shared resolutions k_l; the full source is mixed before computing any winner.
families.concentric_box_mixture: B62-inspired positive finite log-width mixture of whole n-dimensional uniform boxes, exact box-intersection response; not the continuous B62 integral or its lower-bound qualification.

tail_cutoffs: K=0.5sqrt(n),sqrt(n),2sqrt(n), fixed before samples; do not select a favorable K/alpha afterwards.
receiver_importance_sampling: Conditional on true source point y, sample density sup_{1<=L<=2}h_L(x-y)/(1+n log2): core cube1 plus cone shell. The estimator g h_R/q_y is bounded by 1+n log2. This estimates receiver Lebesgue integral S(y), not volume by source probabilities.
square: Two conditionally independent receiver replicates at each source point; their product is unbiased for S(y)^2 before arithmetic errors. Save both profiles; empirical-square bias is avoided.
tail: Plugin tail is biased and explicitly labeled; conservative inner Hoeffding intervals plus outer bounds are allowed and likely broad. No floating-point numerical-zero claim of analytic zero.
response: Complete source response at every finite L node; choose lowest index exact mathematical tie. Grid winner is genuine finite J, not certified continuous supremum. Closed atom-count arrivals; ambiguous boundary/ties separately reported.
confidence: Finite frozen inputs only; confidence does not certify floating-point arithmetic. Use global union budget across records/metrics/source-point bands; no asymptotic extrapolation.
cost: Batched O(outer*inner*2*J*layers*n) coordinate operations; reuse responses for all alpha and K, never multiply geometric evaluation cost by thresholds. Reduce batch memory, not mathematical scope.
stop_rule: Run the registered bounded three rounds and same-n checks only, preserve all empty records; no adaptive input/threshold optimization, no old experiment reruns.
